title: IRC bridge should use silence, not a no-op sentinel
content: For the planned LAN IRC bridge/couch-steering surface in transcript-search, do not copy council's explicit `pass` sentinel into the IRC-facing prompt. Council needs a no-op token because queued fanout envelopes must resolve cleanly; IRC should preserve chat ergonomics. Prompt IRC-directed bros to answer only when useful, and have the bridge suppress empty/low-signal/no-op outputs rather than asking the bro to emit a visible sentinel.
